item.title: FULL RESULTS: 2025 Bar Exam list of passers, topnotchers
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Bar Exam Results 2025, including the complete list of passers and topnotchers for over 11,000 aspiring lawyers, are released by the Supreme Court (SC) after the special en banc session on Wednesday, January 7, 2026, four (4) months after the grueling exams. item.title: FULL LIST: 2025 Bar Exam Results
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Supreme Court Associate Justice Amy C. Lazaro-Javier, Chairperson of the 2025 Bar Examinations Committee, announced on January 7, 2026 (Wednesday), the full results of the 2025 Bar Exam, including full list of passers, topnotchers, and top schools. Lazaro-Javier said 5,594 out of 11,420 (48.98%) passed the 2025 Bar Exam. Bar 2025 Results Pages Main Page: 2025 Bar Exam

item.title: Against the Tide: A Fisherman’s Climb to the Bar Exam Top 6
item.description: At dawn on Bantayan Island, where survival depends on the mercy of the sea, Jeowy Loyloy Ompad learned early that dreams, like nets, must be pulled patiently and with all one’s strength. For years, Ompad spent his mornings hauling fishing nets alongside fellow fishermen, never imagining that one day he would haul himself into the elite ranks of the Philippine Bar.
